provenance.asset_description: Ikeshti, artist David Franco; A small, red scaled bipedal lizard stands seriously as they inspect a mechanical contraption in their hands—a tiny robot with three visual sensors and four skittering insectile legs. There’s a scar over their left eye and a longrifle stowed over their shoulder.
